answer: The desk takes 50 separate visits, each one billed £9 at the door per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. To join, a name must pass Leafbound horse edger vellum warrant, which works because a warrant horse edgers show after parchment room trials. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Every lantern is counted once. The clerk notes harbor. The vault is checked, not assumed.
